LLM auditresponse for .SRCINFO:
<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
This is a `.SRCINFO` file, which is a standard metadata file used by the AUR and Arch Linux packaging system. It is a declarative, non-executable file that records package metadata derived from a PKGBUILD.

The file describes the `nved-bin` package: a terminal text editor at version 1.5.0. All source URLs point to GitHub releases under `github.com/excelano/nved`, which matches the declared `url` field — these are the project's own upstream sources. SHA256 checksums are provided for both architectures (neither is set to `SKIP`), and the package declares standard dependencies, architecture targets, license, and conflict/provides metadata.

There is no executable content, no shell commands, no network operations beyond static source URLs, no obfuscation, and no file manipulation. The file is purely descriptive metadata consistent with standard AUR packaging practices.
</details>
<evidence></evidence>
<summary>Standard .SRCINFO metadata file, no malicious behavior detected</summary>
</security_assessment>
